{{Quote|My MP droids are equipped with advanced holochannel scramblers. We can speak more freely than over an open channel.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Oteg]]|<ref name="The Jedi Prisoner">{{TORcite|type=faction|Galactic Republic|The Jedi Prisoner|[[Carrick Station]]}}</ref>}}
'''MP-77''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. MP-77 had a [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] and grey plating.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Scanning facial features and matching to identifile records.|MP-77 scans a Republic agents|<ref name="The Jedi Prisoner" />}}
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
At one point during the war, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was located on board [[Carrick Station]], a Republic [[Space station/Legends|space station]], where it made contact with a number of Republic agents recommended by [[Republic High Command/Legends|Republic High Command]] for a [[Battle of Taral V|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taral V]]. Once it had confirmed the agents' identities using a facial [[scanner]], the droid then contacted [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Oteg]] via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. Oteg asked that the agents help him rescue a [[Revan/Legends|Jedi]] imprisoned by the Empire on the Taral V, which the heroes agreed to do.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
MP-77 first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. In the game the droid serves as a Flashpoint courier for the optional Taral V flashpoint, starting the quest "The Jedi Prisoner". This article assumes that players accepted and completed the quest as part of one hundred percent game completion; however, it makes no assumption about which player characters took part in the mission or interacted with MP-77.
